Title: Customer Registration and Login
Preconditions: MongoDB running and backend API started
Steps: 1. Navigate to /register | 2. Fill in name email password phone and select 'customer' role | 3. Submit registration form | 4. Verify redirect to home page | 5. Log out | 6. Navigate to /login | 7. Enter credentials | 8. Submit login form
Test Data: Name: John Customer | Email: john@example.com | Password: test123 | Phone: 555-0100 | Role: customer
Expected Result: User successfully registers with JWT token stored in localStorage and redirects to home. Login succeeds and user dashboard displays customer navigation.

Title: Dealer Inventory Management
Steps: 1. Navigate to /dealer-dashboard | 2. Click 'Add Vehicle' button | 3. Fill in make model year VIN basePrice color mileage stockQuantity | 4. Submit form | 5. Verify vehicle appears in table | 6. Click 'Edit' on vehicle | 7. Update basePrice | 8. Submit changes | 9. Verify dynamic price recalculated
Test Data: Make: Toyota | Model: Camry | Year: 2024 | VIN: 1HGBH41JXMN109186 | BasePrice: 35000 | Color: Silver | Mileage: 0 | StockQuantity: 5
Expected Result: Vehicle created successfully. Edit updates vehicle and dynamic pricing calculation runs showing currentPrice different from basePrice based on demand and inventory factors.

Title: Vehicle Booking with Real-Time Stock Update
Preconditions: Customer logged in and available vehicles exist
Steps: 1. Navigate to /inventory | 2. Click 'Book Now' on available vehicle | 3. Confirm booking | 4. Check booking confirmation | 5. Verify vehicle stockQuantity decremented | 6. Check booking price locked at current dynamic price
Expected Result: Booking created with status 'pending'. Vehicle stockQuantity decreases by 1. If stockQuantity reaches 0 status changes to 'reserved'. Booking captures currentPrice as bookingPrice.

Title: Test Drive Scheduling and Approval
Preconditions: Customer and Dealer accounts exist with vehicles
Steps: 1. Customer navigates to /test-drives | 2. Click schedule new test drive | 3. Select vehicle date and time | 4. Submit request | 5. Dealer logs in and navigates to /test-drives | 6. Clicks approve on request | 7. Add dealer notes | 8. Submit approval
Test Data: ScheduledAt: 2026-05-10T14:00:00Z | VehicleId: existing vehicle | CustomerNotes: Interested in safety features
Expected Result: Test drive created with status 'requested'. Dealer can see request. Approval changes status to 'approved' with approvedBy and approvedAt fields populated.

Title: Loan Application and Review Workflow
Preconditions: Customer logged in and Financial Institution user exists
Steps: 1. Customer navigates to /loans | 2. Click 'Apply for Loan' | 3. Fill requestedAmount termMonths annualIncome creditScore vehicleId | 4. Submit application | 5. Financial institution logs in | 6. Views loan applications | 7. Updates status to 'approved' with approvedAmount and interestRate | 8. Submit review
Test Data: RequestedAmount: 30000 | TermMonths: 60 | AnnualIncome: 75000 | CreditScore: 720 | VehicleId: existing vehicle
Expected Result: Loan created with status 'submitted'. Financial institution can review. Approval updates status with reviewedBy reviewedAt approvedAmount and interestRate fields populated.

Title: Complete Customer Journey from Registration to Booking
Preconditions: Clean database and all services running
Steps: 1. Register as customer | 2. Browse /inventory page | 3. View AI recommendations | 4. Click on vehicle to track browsing history | 5. Update preferences via /auth/preferences | 6. Refresh inventory to see updated recommendations | 7. Book a vehicle | 8. Navigate to /bookings to see confirmation
Test Data: Customer profile with preferences: priceRange {min: 20000 max: 40000} preferredMakes: ['Honda' 'Toyota'] preferredColors: ['Blue' 'Black']
Expected Result: Customer successfully completes registration. Browsing history tracked. Recommendations appear based on preferences. Booking completes with confirmation number. MyBookings page displays booking with vehicle details.

Title: Vehicle Booking with Insufficient Stock
Preconditions: Customer logged in and vehicle with stockQuantity = 0
Steps: 1. Navigate to /inventory | 2. Attempt to click 'Book Now' on out-of-stock vehicle
Expected Result: Button is disabled showing 'Out of Stock'. API returns 400 error if attempted programmatically with message 'Vehicle is not available for booking'.

Title: Test Drive Slot Conflict Validation
Preconditions: Two test drives scheduled for same vehicle in overlapping time
Steps: 1. Customer1 schedules test drive for VehicleA at 2026-05-10T14:00:00Z | 2. Customer2 attempts to schedule test drive for same VehicleA at 2026-05-10T14:30:00Z | 3. Submit second request
Test Data: VehicleId same for both customers. Times overlap within 1-hour slot window
Expected Result: Second test drive request fails with validation error 'Time slot conflict for this vehicle'. First test drive remains with status 'requested'.

Title: Dynamic Pricing Calculation with High Demand
Preconditions: Vehicle with high viewCount and bookingCount
Steps: 1. Dealer adds vehicle with basePrice 30000 | 2. Simulate 100 views via API GET /api/vehicles/:id | 3. Create 10 bookings programmatically | 4. Trigger dynamic pricing update | 5. Verify currentPrice increased
Expected Result: CurrentPrice calculated as basePrice * (1 + viewCount*0.001 + bookingCount*0.01 + inventoryFactor). With given values currentPrice should be approximately 30000 * 1.20 = 36000.

Title: Role-Based Access Control for Dealer Routes
Steps: 1. Login as dealer | 2. Navigate to /dealer-dashboard | 3. Verify access granted | 4. Attempt to add vehicle | 5. Verify vehicle created with dealerCode matching logged-in dealer
Expected Result: Dealer can access /dealer-dashboard. Can create vehicles. Vehicles automatically tagged with dealer's dealerCode. Cannot edit or delete vehicles belonging to other dealers.

Title: AI Recommendation System Based on Browsing History
Preconditions: Customer with browsing history and preferences set
Steps: 1. Customer views 5 vehicles of make 'Honda' | 2. Views 3 vehicles with color 'Blue' | 3. Navigate to /inventory | 4. Check recommendations section
Test Data: BrowsingHistory: 8 vehicles viewed with specific makes and colors | Preferences: preferredMakes ['Honda' 'Toyota'] preferredColors ['Blue']
Expected Result: Recommendations section displays vehicles with higher recommendation scores. Vehicles matching browsing history (Honda Blue) appear at top. Score calculation: +3 for make match +2 for color match +2 for newer vehicles +1 for lower price.

Title: Unauthorized Access to Protected Routes
Steps: 1. Attempt GET /api/bookings without token | 2. Attempt POST /api/vehicles as customer | 3. Attempt PATCH /api/loans/:id/status as customer | 4. Verify each returns 401 or 403
Test Data: No auth token or customer role attempting dealer/financial routes
Expected Result: API returns 401 'Authentication required' for no token. Returns 403 'Insufficient permissions' for wrong role. Frontend redirects unauthenticated users to /login when accessing protected pages.

Title: Invalid Loan Application Submission
Preconditions: Customer submitting loan with invalid data
Steps: 1. Login as customer | 2. Navigate to /loans | 3. Attempt to submit with requestedAmount < 0 | 4. Attempt with termMonths > 96 | 5. Attempt with creditScore > 850
Expected Result: Validation errors returned from API. Frontend displays error messages. No loan application created. Mongoose validators prevent invalid data from being saved.

Title: Duplicate VIN Restriction
Preconditions: Dealer attempting to add vehicle with existing VIN
Steps: 1. Dealer1 adds vehicle with VIN ABC123XYZ | 2. Dealer2 attempts to add different vehicle with same VIN ABC123XYZ | 3. Submit form
Test Data: VIN: ABC123XYZ already exists in database
Expected Result: API returns 400 error 'Duplicate VIN'. Frontend displays error message. No duplicate vehicle created. MongoDB unique index on VIN field enforces constraint.
